headline: StarCraft returns in 2030 as an open-world shooter
summary: Blizzard is reviving its StarCraft universe as an open-world shooter in 2030. This marks a new attempt after the canceled StarCraft: Ghost from 2002. The project aims to reimagine the franchise in a 3D shooter format.

headline: Sylvan Esso think you should splurge on good-quality yogurt
summary: Electro-pop duo Sylvan Esso discuss their music journey since 2014. They touch on their successful albums and evolving sound. Amelia Meath and Nick Sanborn also share their unlikely opinion on yogurt quality.

headline: Anthropic CEO says it's time to pump the brakes on AI
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for a slowdown in AI development. He proposes a three-step plan to 'pace the frontier' of AI. Third-party evaluators will gain access to Anthropic models for safety.

headline: LG responds to TV spying allegations
summary: LG is refuting claims that its smart TVs log and upload user data. Earlier reports detailed alarming findings from security researchers. The company states recent media coverage has caused misconceptions.

headline: Blizzard's Big BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony Mic Drop Is World of Warcraft Forever
summary: Blizzard concluded BlizzCon 2026 with a major announcement. The company revealed 'World of Warcraft Forever.' This appears to be a significant expansion or continuation for the popular MMORPG.

headline: Blizzard Shadow-Drops New Campaign for Warcraft 3 at BlizzCon 2026
summary: Blizzard unexpectedly released a new campaign for Warcraft 3. The 'shadow-drop' occurred during BlizzCon 2026. Fans can now play fresh content for the classic real-time strategy game.

headline: Diablo 5 Announced
summary: Blizzard officially announced Diablo 5 at BlizzCon 2026. The ARPG is set 100 years after Diablo 4 in a post-apocalyptic future. Diablo 5 is slated for release in 2029.

headline: Overwatch 2 Gets New Vampire-Inspired Support Hero, Map, and Big Character Reworks
summary: Overwatch 2 introduces a new vampire-inspired support hero. A new map and Act III conclusion for The Reign of Talon storyline arrive. Several significant character reworks are also part of the update.

headline: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days as crypto investor matches record
summary: Reform party received a second massive £36 million donation within two days. A crypto investor matched a previous record-breaking contribution. Rival parties renew calls for caps on individual donations.

headline: Burnham and Badenoch revive red versus blue politics as Reform land 'gobsmacking' donations
summary: Labour and Conservative parties reignite traditional political divides. This comes as Reform receives significant, 'gobsmacking' donations. The BBC's Laura Kuenssberg analyzes the shift as Reform's poll numbers dip.

headline: Trump says united Ireland would be 'fantastic' during visit to Dublin
summary: Donald Trump commented on a united Ireland during his Dublin visit. He called the prospect 'fantastic' in a meeting with Micheál Martin. Downing Street reaffirms commitment to the Good Friday Agreement.

headline: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, urges a deceleration in AI development. He highlights growing concerns about AI's potential for global damage. This call aims to mitigate risks associated with advanced AI models.
